name: rule-get
description: Read the tenant-scoped HTML fragment generation rules for one exact language and one exact scene from the Tradebee Website Builder Open API. Use this before generating `blog.description`, `faq.answer`, `products.description`, `productsgroup.section.top`, `productsgroup.section.bottom`, or `custompage.content`.

language.description: Required. Exact site language code. Select it from `languages-get` after user confirmation. Do not guess, translate, or invent this value.

scene.description: Required. Exact HTML rule scene. Use only one fixed supported value and do not shorten, translate, or rename it.

status.description: Request status. `true` indicates success and `false` indicates failure.

data.description: Returned rule payload from the selected language and scene.
